metadata.description: Hackathon plugins for Solace Technical Support

plugins.name: support-rma
plugins.description: List available replacement serial numbers from the live Shipment Inventory Record; foundation for automated RMA generation.

plugins.name: support-jira
plugins.description: Collect a support case's serial number and support plan, then decrypt and extract the customer's gather-diagnostics bundle; foundation for automated Jira ticket drafting.

plugins.name: support-rma-jira
plugins.description: Raise standardized OPS RMA Jira tickets for Solace appliance hardware replacements (PSU/ADB/NAB/SFP/full appliance): parses an extracted gather-diagnostics bundle, applies the Platinum / Platinum+ conventions, previews for review, then creates the ticket via the Atlassian MCP.
